blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — As weather patterns become increasingly unpredictable, water security depends not only on having enough supply today, but also on developing diverse and resilient sources that can withstand the challenges of tomorrow. Manila Water continues to expand its Laguna de Bay water supply system as a key component of its long-term strategy to sustain reliable, 24/7 water service across the East Zone. By drawing from Laguna de Bay, the company gains greater operational flexibility and reduces its reliance on the Angat-Ipo-La Mesa system, particularly during prolonged dry periods and lower water allocations.
